title: DoMe REST bodies that cross component boundaries
description: Request and response bodies exchanged between the PWA or the agent and cloud-api. Both clients validate responses at the boundary; cloud-api tests validate its responses against these definitions. Error responses always use `error_body`. Every object is closed (additionalProperties:false); additive changes bump the protocol MINOR version. New PWA-only endpoints (PROTOCOL.md §19) are additive without a version bump.

pairing_start_request.description: POST /v1/pairing/start (PC bearer). The PC generated the code locally and sends only its hash.

pairing_status_response.description: POST /v1/pairing/claim (202) and GET /v1/pairing/{pairing_id}. `claimed` = waiting for approval on the PC (which may be offline; the relay re-delivers the request when it connects). Since 1.4 an approved pairing whose agent sent pc_key_mac also carries pc_key{public_jwk, mac}: the PC's identity key and the MAC the phone verifies with the pairing code before pinning it (rules.pc_key_pinning). Never present before approval.

plans_response.description: GET /v1/plans (public): plans.json content, display prices, whether checkout exists and in which Stripe mode, and whether the AI assistant is switched on (ai_enabled false: AI allowances are listed but cannot be used yet)

billing_checkout_response.description: POST /v1/billing/checkout and /v1/billing/topup: a Stripe-hosted page to redirect to. Nothing is unlocked by returning from it.

billing_status_response.description: GET /v1/account/billing: everything the Billing page shows about the account's own plan. subscription is null when no subscription row is live.

checkout_plans.description: The paid plans a Free customer can buy now (empty when checkout_available is false). pro_plus is absent while the AI assistant is switched off: its AI requests are its only difference from pro.

plan_selection_response.description: GET and 200 PUT /v1/account/plan-selection: which devices stay enabled after a downgrade, and until when the choice can be made here.

support_ticket_request.description: POST /v1/support/tickets. `diagnostics` is the customer-reviewed, already-redacted bundle as JSON text (component versions, connection states, error codes, timing only); the server passes it through its redactor again before storing. Never contains pairing material, credentials, typed text, media titles or URLs.

error_code.description: The error the customer was looking at, preselected by the help link.

reference.description: Human-readable reference shown to the customer after successful receipt.

response_expectation.description: Present only when the operator configured one (DOME_SUPPORT_RESPONSE_EXPECTATION); never a default promise.

answer.description: Operator answer, when status is answered or closed.

support_tickets_response.description: GET /v1/support/tickets (the account's own tickets, newest first, at most 50)

assistant_text.description: Words the owner said or typed, or a line DoMe spoke. Printable text: no control characters, no format characters (bidi overrides, zero-width), no line or paragraph separators.

assistant_capability.description: Grant capabilities that matter to the assistant (never pointer or keyboard: rules.ai_eligibility).

assistant_context.description: Coarse state the phone chooses to share. Closed: enums and numbers only, apart from the persona's two pattern-limited words. No titles, app names, tab or window text, search queries or results text.

assistant_turn_request.description: POST /v1/assistant/turn (session + CSRF). turn_id is generated by the phone per turn and never reused; the phone never retries a turn automatically.

assistant_step.description: A step the assistant proposes. action is checked against actions.json (ai_eligible) and params against the action's params schema by cloud-api, again by the phone and again by the PC. app is a spoken app name the phone resolves against its local approved-app list; never an id, path or argument.

assistant_allowance.description: kind: none (no AI on this plan), taste (Free's one-time requests), windows (a 5-hour and a weekly window). starts_at/ends_at are null while no window is open (the next request opens one). used counts charged turns only. exhausted names what stops a new turn: taste, window, week, cost_cap or failures; resets_at is when that bucket ends (null for taste). topup.balance is spendable only while topup.allowed.

assistant_turn_response.description: 200 POST /v1/assistant/turn. In mode act the phone ignores reply and announces the validated steps and their real results itself.

assistant_consent_version.description: The consent text version the PWA shows and cloud-api requires. Changing the consent copy changes this value in both, through this schema.
